name: Table of Contents Generator – SmartTOC Lite
author: SinergoData

sections.description:
SmartTOC Lite automatically creates a SEO-friendly table of contents based on your content’s headings (H2, H3, etc.). Works with posts, pages, and custom post types. Helps improve user experience and on-page SEO. Lightweight, fast, and easy to configure.

Main features include:

  • ✅ Automatic insertion into posts, pages, or custom post types
  • 🎨 Full visual customization (fonts, colors, spacing, borders, toggle style, and more)
  • 🧪 Live preview inside the admin panel
  • ⚙️ Shortcode support: [smart_toc]
  • 🔠 Custom heading levels (h1–h6)
  • 🧭 Expand/Collapse toggle with icon customization
  • ♿ Accessibility-first markup and behavior
  • 🌐 Clean HTML structure, ready for SEO

Shortcode example:

`[smart_toc heading_levels="h2,h3" title="On this page"]```

Credits

Developed by SinergoData
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → SmartTOC Lite to configure your preferences.
  4. Optionally, use [smart_toc] shortcode anywhere you want a manual TOC.
sections.faq:
Can I use it manually only?

Yes. Just disable auto-insert and use the [smart_toc] shortcode wherever you need.

Is it compatible with all themes?

Yes. The plugin outputs clean, theme-independent HTML and CSS, and includes enough styling options to match most designs.

Can I hide the TOC on a specific post?

Yes. You can disable it per post using the checkbox in the post editor.
